motivation: Select exact episodic writes by reduction of the rank-16 AV defect tail rather than attention mass, temporal decay, or K/V deviation.
leakage_policy: The residual-width selector reads the same-record dense AV defect and is an explicitly non-deployable oracle.
Dense mass and value leverage selectors read full dense attention and are explicitly non-deployable oracle baselines.
The K/V-deviation selector may use runtime Q/K/V but never dense attention or dense AV.
No held-out record may fit a reusable basis, selector, or predictor in this screen.
stop_rules: Stop residual-width predictor and kernel work if the width oracle misses both strict quality gates.
Treat a relative improvement without a strict quality pass as a mechanism signal only, not a deployable result.
Do not claim speedup from token-count arithmetic reduction or from any oracle selector.
